title: CO2 supply empty or tank valve closed
symptoms: Flat drinks on every valve; no fizz; CO2 gauge needle in the red zone
root_cause: The CO2 cylinder ran empty or its valve was left closed after a tank swap, so the carbonator cannot carbonate the water
fix_steps: Check that the CO2 cylinder valve is fully open (turn counter-clockwise)|Look at the cylinder gauge; if the needle is in the red zone, swap to a full cylinder|Pour a test drink from each valve and check the fizz

title: Bag-in-box empty or disconnected
symptoms: One flavor watery or clear; syrup line sputtering; flavor tastes like soda water
root_cause: The syrup bag for that flavor is empty or its connector came off, so only carbonated water pours
fix_steps: Find the bag-in-box for the affected flavor on the syrup rack|If the bag is empty, replace it with a new bag of the same flavor and click the connector on firmly|Pour from that valve until syrup flows steadily

title: Carbonator pump failure
symptoms: Flat or watery drinks on all valves even with a full CO2 tank; carbonator pump runs constantly or hums; motor hot to the touch
root_cause: The carbonator pump is not pushing water into the carbonator tank at full pressure, so water passes through under-carbonated
fix_steps: Shut off water and CO2 to the carbonator and unplug the unit|Remove the carbonator pump motor assembly|Install a new carbonator pump motor assembly|Restore water then CO2, purge the carbonator relief valve, and test carbonation

title: Cold plate running warm
symptoms: Drinks warm or lukewarm; ice melting fast; drinks foaming at the nozzle
root_cause: Ice has bridged above the cold plate or the drain is clogged and meltwater pools, so no ice touches the cold plate
fix_steps: Empty and break up the ice in the bin so ice rests on the cold plate|Clear the ice bin drain and replace the drain tube if cracked|Refill the bin and check that drinks pour at 40 degrees F or colder

title: Ice not dispensing
symptoms: No ice comes out of the chute; ice clumped into a block; agitator not turning; grinding noise
root_cause: The ice agitator motor failed or the chute gate jammed, usually with clumped ice in hot weather
fix_steps: Unplug the unit and empty the ice bin|Inspect the agitator and chute gate for clumped ice and free them|Replace the ice agitator motor if it does not turn when powered|Refill with fresh ice and test dispensing

title: Valve leaking or nozzle dripping
symptoms: Drips from a nozzle after pouring; puddle on the drip tray or counter; valve keeps pouring after release
root_cause: A worn or defective valve seal or O-ring lets water or syrup past the closed valve
fix_steps: Shut off water and syrup to the affected valve|Remove the valve and nozzle|Replace the valve seals and O-rings|Reinstall, restore supply, and watch for drips for two minutes

title: Brix out of calibration
symptoms: One flavor tastes watery or too sweet; customers complain about taste
root_cause: Syrup or water flow on that valve has drifted away from the set syrup-to-water ratio
fix_steps: Fit a syrup separator to the valve|Measure syrup and water flows into a brix cup|Adjust the syrup flow control until the ratio matches the manual|Remove the separator and taste-test

title: Clogged or dirty nozzle
symptoms: Weak or uneven stream; drink sprays sideways; slime or mold visible on the nozzle
root_cause: Syrup residue and mold build up in the nozzle and diffuser when daily cleaning is skipped
fix_steps: Pull off the nozzle and diffuser by hand|Soak them in warm water with sanitizer for 10 minutes, then rinse|Wipe the underside of the valve and push the nozzle back on

title: Ice bridging over cold plate

root_cause: In hot weather ice fuses into a bridge above the cold plate or the drain clogs, so the cold plate is not in contact with ice
fix_steps: Break up and remove the ice bridge|Clear the bin drain and replace the drain tube if cracked|Refill with fresh ice and check that drinks pour at 40 degrees F or colder

title: Screen dark (power or breaker)
symptoms: Screen is black; nothing lights up; unit silent
root_cause: The unit is unplugged, its power strip is switched off, or the circuit breaker tripped
fix_steps: Check that the unit's plug is firmly in the outlet|Check the breaker for the dispenser circuit and reset it once if tripped|If the breaker trips again, stop and call for service

title: Low CO2 (error E-21)
symptoms: Screen shows E-21; flat drinks
root_cause: The CO2 cylinder is empty or its valve is closed
fix_steps: Check that the CO2 cylinder valve is fully open|If the gauge needle is in the red zone, swap to a full cylinder|Clear the E-21 alert on the screen and pour a test drink

title: Valve solenoid fault (error E-34)
symptoms: Screen shows E-34; one flavor will not pour; clicking sound
root_cause: A valve solenoid coil failed or its connector worked loose
fix_steps: Power down the unit|Open the front service panel and check the solenoid connector for the affected valve|Replace the valve solenoid coil|Power up and test-pour

title: Nozzle or valve leaking
symptoms: Drips under the nozzle cluster; puddle in the drip tray; E-50 drip tray full
root_cause: A worn or defective valve seal or O-ring in the nozzle cluster
fix_steps: Power down and shut off water and syrup|Remove the nozzle cluster|Replace the valve seals and O-rings|Reassemble and watch for drips for two minutes

title: Flavor sold out (error E-12)
symptoms: Screen shows a flavor sold out; E-12; one flavor greyed out
root_cause: The bag-in-box for that flavor is empty or disconnected
fix_steps: Find the bag-in-box for the flavor shown on screen|Replace the empty bag with a new one of the same flavor and click the connector on|Pour that flavor until syrup flows and the E-12 alert clears

title: Refrigeration running warm (error E-40)
symptoms: Screen shows E-40; warm drinks; loud fan or no fan noise
root_cause: The condenser fan failed or the condenser coils are clogged with dust, worst in hot weather
fix_steps: Power down the unit|Clean the condenser coils|Replace the condenser fan motor if it does not spin|Power up and confirm drinks drop to 40 degrees F or colder within 30 minutes

title: Carbonator pump failure
symptoms: Flat drinks on every connected dispenser; pump runs nonstop; motor hot
root_cause: The carbonator pump is not delivering water to the tank at pressure
fix_steps: Shut off water and CO2 and unplug the carbonator|Replace the carbonator pump motor assembly|Restore water then CO2, purge the relief valve, and test carbonation

title: Low water pressure or clogged filter
symptoms: Weak flow on all valves; pump cycles on and off; watery drinks
root_cause: A clogged water filter cartridge or low incoming water pressure starves the pump
fix_steps: Check incoming water pressure at the inlet gauge|Replace the water filter cartridge|Clean the inlet strainer screen|Test flow at each connected dispenser

title: Relief valve leaking
symptoms: Water spraying or dripping from the top of the carbonator tank; hissing
root_cause: The relief valve is worn or the tank is over-pressured
fix_steps: Shut off CO2 and water|Check the CO2 regulator setting against the manual|Replace the carbonator tank relief valve|Restore supply and check for leaks
